# microscopy.com

> > A comprehensive microscopy research and development platform featuring advanced electron microscopy tools, telePresence instrumentation, and analytical technologies led by Nestor Zaluzec.

microscopy.com serves as a hub for cutting-edge microscopy research, education, and remote instrumentation access. The site aggregates multiple specialized platforms including virtual microscope systems, analytical instruments, and collaborative research tools developed by leading microscopy researchers and institutions.

## Key Topics

- Electron Microscopy
- TelePresence Microscopy
- PicoProbe
- Virtual Microscope
- Scanning Confocal EM
- Analytical Instruments
- Remote Microscopy
- Microanalysis
- ZNL
- MMC
- MicroScape
- Nestor Zaluzec
- Scientific Tools
- Microscopy Education

## Core Research Platforms

- [Nestor's Development Site](http://microscopy.com/): Primary microscopy research hub featuring ZNL, MMC, and MicroScape tools for advanced analysis
- [Zaluzec Community Platform](http://zaluzec.microscopy.com/): Collaborative microscopy platform integrating telePresence, picoProbe, and research resources
- [Virtual Microscope & TelePresence](http://ns.microscopy.com/): Nestor's virtual microscope system with telePresence capabilities, plasma cleaning, and picoProbe integration

## Analytical Instruments

- [Olympus Microscopy Research](http://www.olympus.microscopy.com/): Olympus analytical instruments and electron microscopy research development platform

## Educational Resources & Tutorials

- [HCS TelePresence Microscopy](http://hcs.microscopy.com/): Comprehensive tutorials for telePresence microscopy and picoProbe resources in electron microscopy
- [Virtual Microscope Education](http://vmw.rnsa.microscopy.com/): Educational resources and telePresence microscopy tutorials for virtual microscope systems
